eligibility.criteria_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* A man or woman over 19 years old.
* Sign on ICF prior to study participation

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of Fibromyalgia, Myopathy etc (CK ≥ 2 X ULN)
* Other exclusions applied
